=== Sentencing Sword ===
* Always leaves at least 1 HP remaining.
* Grants {{status|Shield|a=3000|t=3.5T}} regardless of HP consumed.

=== Empress-Justice's Virtue ===
* Restores 10% of caster's HP upon using [[Dispel|buff-removing skills]].
** Does not need to remove a buff in order to activate.
